newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Tallinn Pharma eyes official market list.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Tallinn Pharma eyes official market list.

text.p: Estonian drug company Tallinn Pharmaceutical said on Friday that it hoped to get a listing on the main list of the Baltic state's stock market.
The company, 10 percent of whose stock was placed yesterday with Scandinavian and London investors, is quoted on the free market, over-the-counter trade that can be followed real-time.
Deputy general director Alan Rein said that Tallinn Pharmaceutical had already applied for a quote on the official list of the stock market, which currently has mainly banks.
"The main list provides more publicity and helps to find capital if we need it," Rein told Reuters.
The company's application will probably be discussed in the second week of October, stock exchange managing director Helo Meigas told Reuters.
The company's first-half profit was 13.8 million kroons and its turnover was 70 million kroons.
Rein said the company had plans to vary its products and enlarge its area of activity.
"We would like to decrease Russia's share of our exports and raise it in other CIS countries and also to eastern and central European countries," Rein added.
